enriched_activities.desc: Lies down on bed. Pulls blanket over body. Closes eyes. Falls asleep. Turns to left side. Turns to right side. Adjusts pillow. Remains asleep.

Wakes up. Sits up on bed. Stands up. Walks to bathroom. Turns on bathroom light. Uses toilet. Flushes toilet. Turns on tap. Washes hands. Picks up toothbrush. Applies toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Turns off tap. Dries hands with towel. Turns off bathroom light. Walks out of bathroom.

Enters kitchen. Opens refrigerator. Takes out milk and cereal. Closes refrigerator. Takes bowl from cabinet. Takes spoon from drawer. Pours cereal into bowl. Pours milk into bowl. Sits at table. Eats cereal with spoon. Drinks milk from glass. Places bowl and spoon in sink. Wipes mouth with napkin.

Enters bedroom. Opens closet. Takes out shirt and pants. Closes closet. Takes off pajamas. Puts on shirt. Puts on pants. Puts on socks. Puts on shoes. Stands in front of mirror. Brushes hair. Puts on deodorant. Picks up bag. Walks to door.

Walks out of house. Locks door. Walks to bus stop. Waits for bus. Checks phone. Bus arrives. Boards bus. Pays fare. Finds seat. Sits down. Looks out window. Listens to music. Gets off bus. Walks to workplace. Enters building.

Arrives at office. Greets colleagues. Sits at desk. Turns on computer. Logs in. Checks emails. Answers phone. Talks to clients. Attends meeting. Takes notes. Makes phone calls. Organizes files. Writes reports. Makes photocopies. Takes lunch break. Eats lunch. Returns to desk. Continues working. Turns off computer. Leaves office.
Walks out of office. Walks to bus stop. Waits for bus. Boards bus. Pays fare. Finds seat. Sits down. Looks out window. Gets off bus. Walks home. Unlocks door. Enters house.
Walks into living room. Puts bag on couch. Sits on couch. Turns on TV. Changes channel. Watches TV. Picks up phone. Checks messages. Puts phone down. Leans back. Watches TV.

Walks to kitchen. Opens refrigerator. Takes out vegetables and meat. Closes refrigerator. Takes cutting board from drawer. Places vegetables on cutting board. Picks up knife. Chops vegetables. Opens cabinet. Takes out pot. Places pot on stove. Turns on stove. Adds oil to pot. Adds vegetables to pot. Stirs with spoon. Adds meat to pot. Stirs. Turns off stove. Places food on plate.
Sits at table. Picks up fork. Eats food. Drinks water. Continues eating. Places fork on plate. Picks up napkin. Wipes mouth. Stands up. Takes plate to sink. Rinses plate.

Walks to kitchen. Opens dishwasher. Places dishes in dishwasher. Closes dishwasher. Turns on dishwasher. Wipes counter with sponge. Walks to living room. Turns on TV. Sits on couch. Changes channel. Watches TV. Picks up remote. Turns up volume. Watches TV. Stands up. Walks to kitchen. Opens refrigerator. Takes out ice cream. Takes spoon. Eats ice cream. Returns to living room. Sits on couch. Continues watching TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Leisure time (watching TV or using computer)
enriched_activities.desc: Sits on couch. Turns on TV. Watches TV. Picks up computer. Opens laptop. Turns on computer. Logs in. Checks social media. Watches video. Closes laptop. Puts laptop down. Picks up phone. Plays game. Puts phone down. Watches TV. Changes channel. Watches movie. Stands up. Walks to kitchen. Gets water. Returns to living room. Sits on couch. Continues watching TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bathroom. Turns on bathroom light. Turns on tap. Washes face. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Turns off tap. Dries face with towel. Turns off bathroom light. Walks to bedroom.
Enters bedroom. Turns off light. Lies down on bed. Pulls blanket over body. Closes eyes. Falls asleep. Turns to left side. Turns to right side. Adjusts pillow. Remains asleep.
